kurz: Butter is itself an [[emulsion|emulsion]] of fat, water and milk protein. That is why it thickens sauces, but burns sooner than oil.
bild_im_kopf: Like a ready-made parcel: fat, water and protein already tied together.
was_passiert: Butter is about four fifths fat; the rest is water and milk protein. The milk protein browns nuttily when heated and then burns. Clarified butter has no water or protein and takes much more heat.
faustregeln: For hard frying use clarified butter or oil; fresh butter only at the end.
Cold butter for mounting sauces and for shortcrust, soft butter for creaming.

rolle.rolle: burns early because of milk protein
